text:
Harper: Heads-up — the ice cream truck we chatted about can swing by the courtyard this Friday at 12:30pm. 🍦
Mike: omg yes 
Sasha: count me in. any vegan options? 
Sam_OfficeOps: Yup, vendor said they can do vegan sorbet + dairy options. Price estimate ~ $4-6 per person depending on choices. Want me to book?
Olivia: please book! I’ll chip in. Do we need exact headcount or just rough?
Sam_OfficeOps: rough is fine but vendor asks for a ballpark to bring enough stock. If we hit >40 they’ll bring extra carts.
Kelly_HR: Quick note — we can cover up to $6/person as a team wellness treat. If folks want fancier sundaes, they can pay on their own. :party_parrot: 
Harper: sweet — RSVP here by Wednesday: tinyurl.com/rdw-icecream (real link)
Mike: fav flavors? I vote salted caramel & matcha. 
Sasha: chocolate chip cookie dough for me. also can someone bring napkins? 
Olivia: I’ll bring napkins + paper plates. 
Sam_OfficeOps: added a note to the vendor to include cones + cups. Also I can set up picnic blankets if courtyard is messy. 
Harper: If anyone needs accessibility accommodations (e.g., can't make it to courtyard), DM me or Sam_OfficeOps and we’ll sort delivery to the 2nd-floor kitchen. 
Kelly_HR: Heads up — we encourage remote folks to sync with their managers if they want to come in for this. No pressure. 
Mike: If it rains, backup plan = order 4-5 large tubs of ice cream to the kitchen, same budget. 
Sasha: Amazing — vote: cone vs cup? I choose cone. :icecream: 
Harper: Cone wins so far. Sam_OfficeOps, go ahead and confirm. Thanks y’all! 
Sam_OfficeOps: Confirming with vendor now — will post official RSVP count + payment note once they reply. ETA ~ 2h.
Deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Event reminder created for Friday 12:15pm in #lunch-plans calendar.
Harper: Legendary teamwork. 
Olivia: Also — if anyone wants karaoke during dessert, I will bring a speaker. no pressure tho 😂
